summary: Improve credit reviews, collections, and receivables reporting with practical tools. Explore the 5-day course and plan your training.
lede: Accounts receivable training helps credit and collections professionals assess customer risk and manage balances through the order-to-cash cycle. Participants practise applying the 5 Cs of credit, setting policy and approval limits, reviewing ageing data, resolving invoice disputes, and prioritizing collections. They also build receivables reports using DSO and CEI measures and plan follow-up with documented controls and customer account information.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who make or support customer credit decisions, resolve receivables issues, and report cash collection performance across the order-to-cash cycle.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with invoicing, customer payment terms, or accounts receivable processes is recommended. No programming experience is required; exercises use credit cases, sample receivables data, and spreadsheet-based analysis.
